reason: Operationalize the preregistered capture-process falsification so HOLDOUT can test whether a selected microstructure feature adds beyond observation-process controls without fitting any new model after HOLDOUT access.

capture_falsification.event_limitation: The frozen event-time panel does not carry raw record-arrival/capture-age fields. Event candidates therefore receive source-version/continuity sensitivity in HOLDOUT, but no newly invented capture proxy is added.
capture_falsification.row_universe: For each clock/depth coordinate, define a separate falsification complete-case universe using target, frozen baseline columns, selected challenger columns, and all supported capture-control columns.
capture_falsification.thinning: Apply the same amendment-011 TRAIN/DEV stable temporal thinning independently to the falsification row universe.
capture_falsification.estimators: Fit capture-only = baseline + capture controls, and selected-plus-capture = baseline + capture controls + frozen selected challenger columns. Both use the same DEV-selected estimator class and exact hyperparameters as the frozen coordinate, with separate StandardScaler objects.
capture_falsification.holdout_test: On the identical HOLDOUT falsification complete-case rows, report capture-only loss minus selected-plus-capture loss. A positive effect supports incremental selected-feature information beyond capture controls; nonpositive effect is labelled capture-confounded for that diagnostic.
capture_falsification.role: Falsification only. These models cannot change candidate identity, selection class, horizon, feature, or selected estimator.

fit_freeze_version_rule: 005f-fit-freeze version 1 predates this operationalization and is non-canonical even if it completes. Version 2 or later must serialize the capture falsification artifacts before pre-HOLDOUT freeze.
